title: Typo Patrol
summary: Find misspelt categories and fix them with case_when() and tolower().
hints: `sort(unique(astronauts$nationality))` lists every spelling. Look for "Hungry", "Malysia" and "Netherland".
`n_distinct(astronauts$occupation)` counts the spellings before; after `mutate(occupation = tolower(occupation))` count them again in `clean`.
